  let observer

  const ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES = [
    'www.claro.com.br',
    'preprod.claro.com.br'
  ]

  const validateIsSingle = (href) => {
    const url = new URL(href)

    const hasInternetId = url.searchParams.has('internetId')
    const hasTvId = url.searchParams.has('tvId')
    const hasFoneId = url.searchParams.has('foneId')
    const hasCelularId = url.searchParams.has('celularId')

    if (hasInternetId && !hasTvId && !hasFoneId && !hasCelularId) {
      return true
    } else {
      return false
    }
  }

  const cityAllowed = [
    'Santos',
    'Olinda',
    'Jaboatão dos Guararapes',
    'Recife',
    'Mirassol'
  ]

  const gettingSingle = () => {
    const cityElement = document.querySelector('.cms-Location-city')

    if (!cityElement) {
      return
    }

    const currentCity = cityElement.textContent

    const isCity = cityAllowed.filter((e) => e === currentCity)

    if (isCity.length > 0) {
      const card360Slots = document.querySelectorAll(
        '#card360-17700365-d400-46bd-b616-a9e217d02629.cms-Card360, #planos.cms-Card360'
      )

      if (card360Slots && card360Slots.length > 0) {
        card360Slots.forEach((slot) => {
          const card360Items = slot.querySelectorAll('.mdn-Card')

          card360Items.forEach((card) => {
            const wasModified = card.getAttribute('data-modified')

            const cardTitle = card.querySelector(
              '.mdn-Card-top .mdn-Card-top-main-title .mdn-Heading'
            )

            const isBandaLargaPage =
              window.location.pathname === '/internet/banda-larga'

            const cardLink = card.querySelector('a')

            const isSingle =
              cardLink &&
              validateIsSingle(cardLink.getAttribute('href'))

            if (
              !wasModified &&
              (!isBandaLargaPage ? isSingle : true)
            ) {
              // Dar um append após o cardPrice com o html desejado
              card.setAttribute('data-modified', 'true')

              const cardTitleHeadingTags = card.querySelector(
                '.mdn-Card-top .mdn-Card-top-header .mdn-Card-top-header-tags'
              )

              const li = `<li class="mdn-Tag mdn-Tag--primary">
                  <p class="mdn-Text mdn-Text--body mdn-Text--xs mdn-Text--medium">
                    <span class="mdn-Icon-casa-relogio mdn-Icon--sm"></span>
                    Instalação em até 24hs
                  </p>
                </li>`

              if (cardTitleHeadingTags) {
                cardTitleHeadingTags.innerHTML = li
              } else {
                const cardTitleHeading = card.querySelector(
                  '.mdn-Card-top .mdn-Card-top-header'
                )

                const newHtml = `
                  <ul class="mdn-Card-top-header-tags">
                    ${li}
                  </ul>
                `

                cardTitleHeading?.insertAdjacentHTML(
                  'beforeend',
                  newHtml
                )
              }
            }
          })
        })
      }
    }
  }

  observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
    gettingSingle()
  })

  const checkObserver = () => {
    // Validação do domínio
    const isAllowedHostname = ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES.includes(
      window.location.hostname
    )

    // Não executa em domínios não permitidos
    if (!isAllowedHostname) {
      return
    }

    // Validação das páginas permitidas
    const isAllowedPath = [
      '/',
      '/internet/banda-larga',
      '/dev/home-mozao-2'
    ].some(
      (path) => window.location.pathname === path
    )

    // Não executa fora das páginas permitidas
    if (!isAllowedPath) {
      return
    }

    // Executa a primeira vez
    gettingSingle()

    // Observa alterações dinâmicas
    observer.observe(document.body, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    })
  }

  checkObserver()
})()</script><script>function cmsAppMinhaClaroScriptInit() {

window.HCMS = window.HCMS || {}

// Utilitário de cookie (precisa estar antes do objeto de config) 
// Pega o valor do cookie pelo nome
function getCookieByName(name) {
  const cookies = document.cookie.split(';')
  for (let cookie of cookies) {
    cookie = cookie.trim()
    if (cookie.startsWith(name + '=')) {
      return cookie.substring(name.length + 1)
    }
  }
  return null
}

// Configurações por path 
// Cada entrada possui uma função `match(pathname)` e um objeto `config`.
// O primeiro perfil cujo `match` retornar true será aplicado.
// Adicione novos perfis conforme necessário; o último serve como fallback (default).
const HCMS_PATH_CONFIGS = [
  {
    // Dev / Martech — logs habilitados, sem exigência de claroid prévio
    matchPattern: new RegExp(/^\/dev\/martech\/?$/),
    config: {
      validate_network_api: false,
      validate_existing_claroid: false,
      use_ipv6: true,
      logs: true,
      logs_html: true,
      event_version_prefix: 'v2',
      MINIMUM_MINUTES: 0,
      MINIMUM_MINUTES_REFRESH_NETWORK: 0,
      restore_old_claroid: false
    }
  },
  {
    // Home / Produção — logs desabilitados, exige claroid cookie prévio
    matchPattern: new RegExp(/^\/(atendimento|atendimento\/2-via-de-conta|celular\/controle|celular\/pos|internet\/banda-larga|claro-tv-mais|claro-tv-mais\/box|multi)?\/?$/),
    config: {
      validate_network_api: false,
      validate_existing_claroid: false,
      use_ipv6: false,
      logs: false,
      logs_html: false,
      event_version_prefix: 'ipv6_',
      MINIMUM_MINUTES: 0,
      MINIMUM_MINUTES_REFRESH_NETWORK: 3,
      restore_old_claroid: false
    }
  }
]

function resolvePathConfig() {
  const path = window.location.pathname
  const entry = HCMS_PATH_CONFIGS.find((e) => e.matchPattern.test(path))
  return entry ? entry.config : {}
}

//  Inicialização do objeto principal 
const _pathConfig = resolvePathConfig()

window.HCMS.claroid = {
  url_api: `https://${window.location.origin.includes('www') ? 'www' : 'preprod'}.claro.com.br/api/segments/claroid`,
  url_network_api: `https://${
    window.location.origin.includes('www') ? 'www' : 'preprod'
  }.claro.com.br/api/segments/network`,
  url_local: 'http://localhost:3000/api/segments/claroid',
  selector: '#martech-text-dev .cms-textOne',
  cookie_asn: window.location.origin.includes('www') ? 'clr_hcms_asn' : 'stg_clr_hcms_asn',
  elementsIds: [
    'cid-cookie',
    'cid-asn',
    'cid-asn-created-at',
    'cid-asn-ip',
    'cid-asn-port',
    'cid-asn-org',
    'cid-response',
    'cid-msg'
  ],
  elements: {},
  oldClaroId: getCookieByName('claroid'),
  validate_network_api: false,
  validate_existing_claroid: false,
  use_ipv6: false,
  logs: false,
  logs_html: false,
  event_version_prefix: '',
  MINIMUM_MINUTES: 0,
  ..._pathConfig
}

// Quando use_ipv6 está ativo, força sempre o endpoint www e ajusta o prefixo
if (window.HCMS.claroid.use_ipv6) {
  window.HCMS.claroid.event_version_prefix = 'ipv6_'
  window.HCMS.claroid.url_network_api = 'https://www.claro.com.br/api/segments/network'
}

if (window.location.hostname === 'localhost') {
  window.HCMS.claroid.url_api = window.HCMS.claroid.url_local
}

// Logs
function logThis(message) {
  if (window.HCMS.claroid.logs) {
    console.log(message)
  }
}

function printThis(elementId, message) {
  if (window.HCMS.claroid.logs_html) {
    const element = window.HCMS.claroid.elements[elementId]
    if (element) {
      element.innerHTML += message + '<br/>'
    }
  }
  logThis(message)
}

logThis(`ClaroID API URL: ${window.HCMS.claroid.url_api}`)

// Network API
async function getNetworkFromAPI() {
  const response = await fetch(window.HCMS.claroid.url_network_api, {
    method: 'GET',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
  })
  return response
}

async function validateNetworkAPI() {
  try {
    const response = await getNetworkFromAPI()
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Erro da API de Network: ${response.status}`)
    const responseData = await response.json()
    const asnCookie = JSON.parse(atob(getCookieByName(window.HCMS.claroid.cookie_asn)))

    // Valida se o IP e Port retornados pela API de Network batem com os do cookie ASN
    if (responseData.asn.ip !== asnCookie.asn.ip || responseData.asn.port !== asnCookie.asn.port) {
      throw new Error(
        `Dados da API de Network não correspondem ao cookie ASN. API IP: ${responseData.asn.ip}, Cookie IP: ${asnCookie.asn.ip}. API Port: ${responseData.asn.port}, Cookie Port: ${asnCookie.asn.port}`
      )
    }
    printThis('cid-msg', `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] Validação da API de Network: ok!`)
    return true
  } catch (error) {
    printThis(
      'cid-msg',
      `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] Erro na validação da API de Network: ${error.message}`
    )
    return false
  }
}

function validateIP(ip, port) {
  // Regex: 0 or 1-9 followed by up to 2 digits, range 0-255, no leading zeros unless single 0
  const ipv4StrictRegex = /^(25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d{2}|[1-9]\d?|0)(\.(25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d{2}|[1-9]\d?|0)){3}$/
  const ipV6Regex = /^(?:[A-Fa-f0-9]{1,4}:){7}[A-Fa-f0-9]{1,4}$|^(?:[A-Fa-f0-9]{1,4}:){3}[A-Fa-f0-9]{1,4}::(?:[A-Fa-f0-9]{1,4}:)[A-Fa-f0-9]{1,4}$/
  const portRegex = /^\d{1,5}$/

  // Valida porta se existir e IP (IPv4 ou IPv6)
  if (port && (!portRegex.test(port) || parseInt(port) > 65535)) throw new Error(`Porta ${port} inválida`)
  if (!ipV6Regex.test(ip) && !ipv4StrictRegex.test(ip)) throw new Error(`IP ${ip} inválido`)
  
  return true
}

// ClaroID API
// ip e port são opcionais: usados quando use_ipv6 está ativo ou tempo de refresh da rede 'MINIMUM_MINUTES_REFRESH_NETWORK' está expirado
async function fetchClaroId(ip, port) {
  try {
    printThis('cid-msg', `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] Validando IP e Porta para chamada da API de ClaroID...`)
    const ipParam = ip && validateIP(ip, port) ? `&ip=${ip}&port=${port}` : ''
    if(!ipParam || ipParam === '') {
      validateIP(HCMS.claroid.ip, HCMS.claroid.port)
    }

    const response = await fetch(`${window.HCMS.claroid.url_api}?hasCookie=1${ipParam}`, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    })

    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Erro da API: ${response.status}`)
    const responseData = await response.json()
    printThis('cid-response', JSON.stringify(responseData))
    printThis('cid-cookie', `from api: ${responseData.id}`)
    printThis('cid-msg', `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] Disparando GA datalayer event 'martech_claroid'`)

    window.dataLayer.push({
      event: 'martech_claroid',
      martech_claroid: window.HCMS.claroid.oldClaroId || 'nao_existente',
      martech_claroid_nao_logado: responseData.id,
      martech_claroid_igual: `${window.HCMS.claroid.event_version_prefix || ''}${
        window.HCMS.claroid.oldClaroId === responseData.id
      }`
    })
    updateSalesforceInfo(responseData.id)

    if (window.HCMS.claroid.restore_old_claroid) {
      deleteCookieByName('claroid')
      recreateOldClaroIdCookie(window.HCMS.claroid.oldClaroId)
    }

    printThis('cid-msg', `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] Retorno da API: ${JSON.stringify(responseData)}`)
  } catch (err) {
    printThis('cid-msg', `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] Retorno da API: ${err.message}`)
    console.error(err)
  }
}

// Utilitários DOM 
// Pega todos os elementos pelos IDs registrados
function getFrontElements() {
  if (window.HCMS.claroid.logs_html) {
    window.HCMS.claroid.elementsIds.forEach((el) => {
      window.HCMS.claroid.elements[el] = document.getElementById(el) || null
    })
  }
}

// Utilitários de cookie 
// Verifica se o cookie ASN existe (resultado do /api/segments/network)
function checkASNCookie() {
  return document.cookie.includes('asn=')
}

// Verifica se o cookie claroid existe
function checkClaroidCookie() {
  return document.cookie.includes('claroid=')
}

// Verifica se o ASN pertence à rede Claro Móvel
function checkClaroMobile(asnData) {
  if (!asnData) return false
  if (asnData.autonomous_system_organization.toLowerCase().includes('claro s.a.')) return true
  if (asnData.organization.toLowerCase().includes('claro brazil')) return true
  return false
}

// Deleta o cookie pelo nome
function deleteCookieByName(name) {
  logThis(`Deletando cookie: ${name}`)

  const deleteAttempts = [
    `${name}=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;`,
    `${name}=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/; domain=${window.location.hostname};`,
    `${name}=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/; domain=.claro.com.br;`
  ]

  deleteAttempts.forEach((cookieString) => {
    document.cookie = cookieString
  })

  if (!getCookieByName(name)) {
    logThis(`Cookie ${name} deletado com sucesso`)
  } else {
    logThis(`Aviso: Cookie ${name} pode não ter sido deletado completamente`)
  }
}

function updateSalesforceInfo(claroId) {
  logThis(`Atualizando SalesforceInteractions com claroid: ${claroId}`)
  try {
    if(window.SalesforceInteractions) {
      logThis(`SalesforceInteractions encontrado - domínio: ${window.SalesforceInteractions.getCookieDomain()}`)
      
      window.SalesforceInteractions.sendEvent({
        interaction: {
          name: `claroid_${window.location.host}${window.location.pathname.replace(/\//g, '_')}`,
          user: {
            identities: {
              claroId: claroId,
              customerId: claroId,
              sfmcContactKey: claroId
            }
          }
        }
      })
    } else {
      logThis('SalesforceInteractions não encontrado')
    }
  } catch (error) {
    logThis('Erro ao obter informações do Salesforce: ' + error.message)
  }
}

function recreateOldClaroIdCookie(claroId) {
  if (claroId) {
    const futureDate = new Date()
    futureDate.setTime(futureDate.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
    const expires = `expires=${futureDate.toUTCString()};`
    const cookieString = `claroid=${claroId}; ${expires} path=/; domain=${window.location.hostname.replace(
      /^(www)/,
      ''
    )};`
    try {
      document.cookie = cookieString
      logThis(`Cookie claroid criado: ${cookieString}`)

      setTimeout(() => {
        const createdValue = getCookieByName('claroid')
        if (createdValue === claroId) {
          logThis('Cookie claroid criado com sucesso')
        } else {
          logThis('Aviso: Problema ao criar cookie claroid')
        }
      }, 100)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Erro ao criar cookie claroid:', error)
    }
  }
}

// Loop principal 
async function waitForNetworkAPI() {
  try {
    getFrontElements()

    printThis('cid-msg', `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] Verificando cookie claroid...`)

    if (checkClaroidCookie()) {
      printThis('cid-cookie', `original: ${getCookieByName('claroid')}`)
    }

    // validate_existing_claroid: true  → aborta se não houver cookie claroid (comportamento home/prod)
    // validate_existing_claroid: false → continua mesmo sem cookie claroid (comportamento dev/martech)
    if (window.HCMS.claroid.validate_existing_claroid && !checkClaroidCookie()) {
      const msg = `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] Cookie claroid não existente, não chamar API`
      printThis('cid-msg', msg)
      return
    }

    let attempts = 0
    const maxAttempts = 30
    let timeout = 1000

    while (attempts < maxAttempts) {
      if (checkASNCookie()) {
        const asncookie = JSON.parse(atob(getCookieByName(window.HCMS.claroid.cookie_asn)))

        if (asncookie) {
          const minutesAgo = asncookie?.asn?.created_at
            ? (Date.now() - new Date(asncookie.asn.created_at).getTime()) / 60000
            : -1
          window.HCMS.claroid.ip = asncookie.asn.ip
          window.HCMS.claroid.port = asncookie.asn.port
          printThis('cid-msg', `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] Cookie ASN encontrado`)
          printThis('cid-asn', JSON.stringify(asncookie.asn))
          printThis('cid-asn-created-at', `${asncookie.asn.created_at} (${minutesAgo} minutos atrás)`)
          printThis('cid-asn-ip', asncookie.asn.ip)
          printThis('cid-asn-port', asncookie.asn.port)
          printThis('cid-asn-org', asncookie.asn.autonomous_system_organization)

          if (checkClaroMobile(asncookie.asn) && minutesAgo >= window.HCMS.claroid.MINIMUM_MINUTES) {
            printThis(
              'cid-msg',
              `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] Rede Claro Móvel identificada. Chamando API...`
            )

            if (window.HCMS.claroid.validate_network_api) {
              const isValid = await validateNetworkAPI()
              if (!isValid) {
                printThis(
                  'cid-msg',
                  `[${new Date().toLocaleString(
                    'pt-BR'
                  )}] Falha na validação da API de Network. Abortando chamada da API de ClaroID.`
                )
                return
              }
            }

            // use_ipv6: busca IP/port frescos da API de rede antes de chamar ClaroID
            if (window.HCMS.claroid.use_ipv6 || minutesAgo >= window.HCMS.claroid.MINIMUM_MINUTES_REFRESH_NETWORK) {
              printThis(
                'cid-msg',
                `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] Buscando dados frescos da rede para chamada da API de ClaroID...`
              )
              const networkResponse = await getNetworkFromAPI()
              const networkData = await networkResponse.json()
              if(!checkClaroMobile(networkData.asn)) {
                printThis(
                  'cid-msg',
                  `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] Não é Rede Claro Móvel.`
                )
                return
              }

              await fetchClaroId(networkData.asn.ip, networkData.asn.port)
              return
            } else {
              // Chama a API de ClaroID usando os dados do cookie ASN (sem buscar dados frescos da rede)
              await fetchClaroId()
              return
            }
          } else {
            let msg = `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}]`
            if (minutesAgo < window.HCMS.claroid.MINIMUM_MINUTES) {
              msg += ` ASN Cookie existe há ${minutesAgo} minutos, aguardando minimo de ${window.HCMS.claroid.MINIMUM_MINUTES} minuto(s) para validar Rede Claro.`
              timeout = (window.HCMS.claroid.MINIMUM_MINUTES - minutesAgo) * 60000 + 500
              printThis('cid-msg', msg)
            }
            if (!checkClaroMobile(asncookie.asn)) {
              msg += ' Não é Rede Claro Móvel.'
              printThis('cid-msg', msg)
              return
            }
          }
        }
      }

      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, timeout))
      attempts++
    }

    const msg = `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] Timeout: Cookie ASN não encontrado`
    printThis('cid-msg', msg)
    console.warn(msg)
  } catch (err) {
    printThis('cid-msg', `[${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}] ${err.message}`)
    console.error(err)
  }
}

window.addEventListener('load', waitForNetworkAPI)

  let observer

  const ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES = [
    'www.claro.com.br',
    'preprod.claro.com.br'
  ]

  const validateIsSingle = (href) => {
    const url = new URL(href)

    const hasInternetId = url.searchParams.has('internetId')
    const hasTvId = url.searchParams.has('tvId')
    const hasFoneId = url.searchParams.has('foneId')
    const hasCelularId = url.searchParams.has('celularId')

    if (hasInternetId && !hasTvId && !hasFoneId && !hasCelularId) {
      return true
    } else {
      return false
    }
  }

  const cityAllowed = [
    'Santos',
    'Olinda',
    'Jaboatão dos Guararapes',
    'Recife',
    'Mirassol'
  ]

  const gettingSingle = () => {
    const cityElement = document.querySelector('.cms-Location-city')

    if (!cityElement) {
      return
    }

    const currentCity = cityElement.textContent

    const isCity = cityAllowed.filter((e) => e === currentCity)

    if (isCity.length > 0) {
      const card360Slots = document.querySelectorAll(
        '#card360-17700365-d400-46bd-b616-a9e217d02629.cms-Card360, #planos.cms-Card360'
      )

      if (card360Slots && card360Slots.length > 0) {
        card360Slots.forEach((slot) => {
          const card360Items = slot.querySelectorAll('.mdn-Card')

          card360Items.forEach((card) => {
            const wasModified = card.getAttribute('data-modified')

            const cardTitle = card.querySelector(
              '.mdn-Card-top .mdn-Card-top-main-title .mdn-Heading'
            )

            const isBandaLargaPage =
              window.location.pathname === '/internet/banda-larga'

            const cardLink = card.querySelector('a')

            const isSingle =
              cardLink &&
              validateIsSingle(cardLink.getAttribute('href'))

            if (
              !wasModified &&
              (!isBandaLargaPage ? isSingle : true)
            ) {
              // Dar um append após o cardPrice com o html desejado
              card.setAttribute('data-modified', 'true')

              const cardTitleHeadingTags = card.querySelector(
                '.mdn-Card-top .mdn-Card-top-header .mdn-Card-top-header-tags'
              )

              const li = `<li class="mdn-Tag mdn-Tag--primary">
                  <p class="mdn-Text mdn-Text--body mdn-Text--xs mdn-Text--medium">
                    <span class="mdn-Icon-casa-relogio mdn-Icon--sm"></span>
                    Instalação em até 24hs
                  </p>
                </li>`

              if (cardTitleHeadingTags) {
                cardTitleHeadingTags.innerHTML = li
              } else {
                const cardTitleHeading = card.querySelector(
                  '.mdn-Card-top .mdn-Card-top-header'
                )

                const newHtml = `
                  <ul class="mdn-Card-top-header-tags">
                    ${li}
                  </ul>
                `

                cardTitleHeading?.insertAdjacentHTML(
                  'beforeend',
                  newHtml
                )
              }
            }
          })
        })
      }
    }
  }

  observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
    gettingSingle()
  })

  const checkObserver = () => {
    // Validação do domínio
    const isAllowedHostname = ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES.includes(
      window.location.hostname
    )

    // Não executa em domínios não permitidos
    if (!isAllowedHostname) {
      return
    }

    // Validação das páginas permitidas
    const isAllowedPath = [
      '/',
      '/internet/banda-larga',
      '/dev/home-mozao-2'
    ].some(
      (path) => window.location.pathname === path
    )

    // Não executa fora das páginas permitidas
    if (!isAllowedPath) {
      return
    }

    // Executa a primeira vez
    gettingSingle()

    // Observa alterações dinâmicas
    observer.observe(document.body, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    })
  }

  checkObserver()
})()</script><script>function cmsAppMinhaClaroScriptInit() {

  let observer

  const ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES = [
    'www.claro.com.br',
    'preprod.claro.com.br'
  ]

  const validateIsSingle = (href) => {
    const url = new URL(href)

    const hasInternetId = url.searchParams.has('internetId')
    const hasTvId = url.searchParams.has('tvId')
    const hasFoneId = url.searchParams.has('foneId')
    const hasCelularId = url.searchParams.has('celularId')

    if (hasInternetId && !hasTvId && !hasFoneId && !hasCelularId) {
      return true
    } else {
      return false
    }
  }

  const cityAllowed = [
    'Santos',
    'Olinda',
    'Jaboatão dos Guararapes',
    'Recife',
    'Mirassol'
  ]

  const gettingSingle = () => {
    const cityElement = document.querySelector('.cms-Location-city')

    if (!cityElement) {
      return
    }

    const currentCity = cityElement.textContent

    const isCity = cityAllowed.filter((e) => e === currentCity)

    if (isCity.length > 0) {
      const card360Slots = document.querySelectorAll(
        '#card360-17700365-d400-46bd-b616-a9e217d02629.cms-Card360, #planos.cms-Card360'
      )

      if (card360Slots && card360Slots.length > 0) {
        card360Slots.forEach((slot) => {
          const card360Items = slot.querySelectorAll('.mdn-Card')

          card360Items.forEach((card) => {
            const wasModified = card.getAttribute('data-modified')

            const cardTitle = card.querySelector(
              '.mdn-Card-top .mdn-Card-top-main-title .mdn-Heading'
            )

            const isBandaLargaPage =
              window.location.pathname === '/internet/banda-larga'

            const cardLink = card.querySelector('a')

            const isSingle =
              cardLink &&
              validateIsSingle(cardLink.getAttribute('href'))

            if (
              !wasModified &&
              (!isBandaLargaPage ? isSingle : true)
            ) {
              // Dar um append após o cardPrice com o html desejado
              card.setAttribute('data-modified', 'true')

              const cardTitleHeadingTags = card.querySelector(
                '.mdn-Card-top .mdn-Card-top-header .mdn-Card-top-header-tags'
              )

              const li = `<li class="mdn-Tag mdn-Tag--primary">
                  <p class="mdn-Text mdn-Text--body mdn-Text--xs mdn-Text--medium">
                    <span class="mdn-Icon-casa-relogio mdn-Icon--sm"></span>
                    Instalação em até 24hs
                  </p>
                </li>`

              if (cardTitleHeadingTags) {
                cardTitleHeadingTags.innerHTML = li
              } else {
                const cardTitleHeading = card.querySelector(
                  '.mdn-Card-top .mdn-Card-top-header'
                )

                const newHtml = `
                  <ul class="mdn-Card-top-header-tags">
                    ${li}
                  </ul>
                `

                cardTitleHeading?.insertAdjacentHTML(
                  'beforeend',
                  newHtml
                )
              }
            }
          })
        })
      }
    }
  }

  observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
    gettingSingle()
  })

  const checkObserver = () => {
    // Validação do domínio
    const isAllowedHostname = ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES.includes(
      window.location.hostname
    )

    // Não executa em domínios não permitidos
    if (!isAllowedHostname) {
      return
    }

    // Validação das páginas permitidas
    const isAllowedPath = [
      '/',
      '/internet/banda-larga',
      '/dev/home-mozao-2'
    ].some(
      (path) => window.location.pathname === path
    )

    // Não executa fora das páginas permitidas
    if (!isAllowedPath) {
      return
    }

    // Executa a primeira vez
    gettingSingle()

    // Observa alterações dinâmicas
    observer.observe(document.body, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    })
  }

  checkObserver()
})()</script><script>function cmsAppMinhaClaroScriptInit() {

  let observer

  const ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES = [
    'www.claro.com.br',
    'preprod.claro.com.br'
  ]

  const validateIsSingle = (href) => {
    const url = new URL(href)

    const hasInternetId = url.searchParams.has('internetId')
    const hasTvId = url.searchParams.has('tvId')
    const hasFoneId = url.searchParams.has('foneId')
    const hasCelularId = url.searchParams.has('celularId')

    if (hasInternetId && !hasTvId && !hasFoneId && !hasCelularId) {
      return true
    } else {
      return false
    }
  }

  const cityAllowed = [
    'Santos',
    'Olinda',
    'Jaboatão dos Guararapes',
    'Recife',
    'Mirassol'
  ]

  const gettingSingle = () => {
    const cityElement = document.querySelector('.cms-Location-city')

    if (!cityElement) {
      return
    }

    const currentCity = cityElement.textContent

    const isCity = cityAllowed.filter((e) => e === currentCity)

    if (isCity.length > 0) {
      const card360Slots = document.querySelectorAll(
        '#card360-17700365-d400-46bd-b616-a9e217d02629.cms-Card360, #planos.cms-Card360'
      )

      if (card360Slots && card360Slots.length > 0) {
        card360Slots.forEach((slot) => {
          const card360Items = slot.querySelectorAll('.mdn-Card')

          card360Items.forEach((card) => {
            const wasModified = card.getAttribute('data-modified')

            const cardTitle = card.querySelector(
              '.mdn-Card-top .mdn-Card-top-main-title .mdn-Heading'
            )

            const isBandaLargaPage =
              window.location.pathname === '/internet/banda-larga'

            const cardLink = card.querySelector('a')

            const isSingle =
              cardLink &&
              validateIsSingle(cardLink.getAttribute('href'))

            if (
              !wasModified &&
              (!isBandaLargaPage ? isSingle : true)
            ) {
              // Dar um append após o cardPrice com o html desejado
              card.setAttribute('data-modified', 'true')

              const cardTitleHeadingTags = card.querySelector(
                '.mdn-Card-top .mdn-Card-top-header .mdn-Card-top-header-tags'
              )

              const li = `<li class="mdn-Tag mdn-Tag--primary">
                  <p class="mdn-Text mdn-Text--body mdn-Text--xs mdn-Text--medium">
                    <span class="mdn-Icon-casa-relogio mdn-Icon--sm"></span>
                    Instalação em até 24hs
                  </p>
                </li>`

              if (cardTitleHeadingTags) {
                cardTitleHeadingTags.innerHTML = li
              } else {
                const cardTitleHeading = card.querySelector(
                  '.mdn-Card-top .mdn-Card-top-header'
                )

                const newHtml = `
                  <ul class="mdn-Card-top-header-tags">
                    ${li}
                  </ul>
                `

                cardTitleHeading?.insertAdjacentHTML(
                  'beforeend',
                  newHtml
                )
              }
            }
          })
        })
      }
    }
  }

  observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
    gettingSingle()
  })

  const checkObserver = () => {
    // Validação do domínio
    const isAllowedHostname = ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES.includes(
      window.location.hostname
    )

    // Não executa em domínios não permitidos
    if (!isAllowedHostname) {
      return
    }

    // Validação das páginas permitidas
    const isAllowedPath = [
      '/',
      '/internet/banda-larga',
      '/dev/home-mozao-2'
    ].some(
      (path) => window.location.pathname === path
    )

    // Não executa fora das páginas permitidas
    if (!isAllowedPath) {
      return
    }

    // Executa a primeira vez
    gettingSingle()

    // Observa alterações dinâmicas
    observer.observe(document.body, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    })
  }

  checkObserver()
})()</script><script>function cmsAppMinhaClaroScriptInit() {
